strings.name: Cher
strings.summary: Cher rose with Sonny & Cher and built a career across pop, television variety and film, known for her contralto voice, costumes and repeated public reinvention. Moonstruck earned her a Best Actress Oscar, while Believe brought a prominent electronic vocal effect into pop. She entered the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and published her first memoir in 2024, receiving a Lifetime Achievement Grammy in 2026.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Music, television and cinema
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from a duo and variety television into solo recording and Oscar-winning acting.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Vocal and stage expression
strings.highlights.h2.text: Believe’s electronic vocals and her changing visual image influenced later pop performance.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Received Lifetime Achievement Grammy
strings.timeline.t1.text: Honored at the Recording Academy’s Special Merit ceremony for her music and wider entertainment career.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Entered Hall of Fame and published memoir
strings.timeline.t2.text: Inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and released Cher: The Memoir, Part One.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released Believe
strings.timeline.t3.text: Dance production and conspicuous electronic vocals began another commercial phase; the title song later won a Grammy.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Won Best Actress Oscar
strings.timeline.t4.text: Received the award for her performance in the 1987 film Moonstruck.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Won Cannes award for Mask
strings.timeline.t5.text: Her portrayal of a mother in Mask earned the festival’s Best Actress award.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Starred in television variety
strings.timeline.t6.text: Launched The Sonny & Cher Comedy Hour with Sonny Bono, expanding her television audience.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Broke through with I Got You Babe
strings.timeline.t7.text: The Sonny & Cher duo became an international success as she also developed solo recordings.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered Los Angeles entertainment
strings.timeline.t8.text: Left school to pursue performance, later meeting Sonny Bono and working in recording.
